narration: PTE Academic, Read Aloud. Step one: Preview. Before you begin speaking, identify difficult words in the passage and prepare their pronunciation. Look at the example sentence about light produced by marine organisms through chemical reactions. Notice three challenging words. First, bioluminescence. Say it smoothly: bio-luminescence. Next, organisms. Keep the syllables clear: or-gan-isms. Finally, illumination. Say: il-loo-mi-nay-shun. During your preview, spot unfamiliar or complex words and practise saying them accurately before you read aloud. This helps you maintain natural fluency instead of pausing in the middle of the sentence. Now you are ready for the next step.
